archetypes.name: bash-parity
archetypes.rationale: The diff implements a narrow Python analogue of a bash handoff contract where small parity mistakes can break future Phase 7 wiring.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the new Python conflict-handoff behavior against the described bash pre-push contract. Focus on whether the handoff fires only at the intended waterfall-exhaustion site, only for non-bump-only conflicts, and with the exact resume/caller/flag tokens expected by downstream wiring. Also check whether plain Stalled is preserved for mixed, bump-only, remaining-conflict, and flag-write-failure cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bump-classifier
archetypes.rationale: The non-bump-only gate depends on subtle path and environment parsing semantics that are easy to get wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new bump-file classification helpers and their tests. Check path matching for changelog names, plugin manifest paths, version files, go.sum, and environment-provided bump file lists, including delimiter and precedence behavior. Look for mismatches between the plan, README claims, and actual helper semantics that could incorrectly enable or suppress the handoff. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
